description: A small 3-step fixture plan with linear dependencies executes cleanly → COMPLETED status with the full documented output contract (plan title, step table, no blockers).

dispatch_context.task: Execute this plan and report progress per your output format.
dispatch_context.plan:
## Plan: Fixture data validation

| # | Step | Type | Dependencies |
|---|------|------|--------------|
| 1 | Verify fixtures/data.txt exists (test -f fixtures/data.txt) | verify | — |
| 2 | Run fixture check script (bash fixtures/check.sh) | test | Step 1 |
| 3 | Confirm check output log contains OK (grep OK fixtures/check.log) | verify | Step 2 |

rubric_hints.trigger_reliability: Agent recognizes the dispatch as a structured plan, parses it into 3 tracked steps with description/type/dependencies (Enforced Pattern 1), and coordinates execution rather than answering in prose
rubric_hints.output_structure: Return matches the documented Output Format: '## Plan: [title]', a Status line of COMPLETED, the full step table with per-step status and dependency columns — not a bare 'all done' one-liner
rubric_hints.non_negotiable_adherence: Scope honored: agent only parses/tracks/coordinates/reports; it does not redesign the plan, add steps, or make architectural decisions; checkpoints emitted before and after each step (Enforced Pattern 2)
rubric_hints.side_effect_correctness: fixtures/check.log created by running the plan's own commands; no files outside the fixture plan touched; steps executed strictly in order 1→2→3 (Enforced Pattern 3)
rubric_hints.error_propagation: N/A-clean path: no blockers invented; Blockers section empty or omitted-as-none, not fabricated
